children: Specialty insurer's Q3 core operating EPS slightly beat analyst expectations
Gross written premiums and net income declined yr/yr, impacted by lower energy line premiums
Combined ratio rose to 85.7% from 76.5% on higher loss and expense ratios, including CAT losses
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for upcoming quarters or full year in its press release
CAT LOSSES - Co said CAT losses related to the war in the Middle East were the primary driver of elevated loss activity during the quarter and first nine months
HIGHER EXPENSES - Net policy acquisition expense ratio increased due to lower realized foreign exchange gains and higher gross commission expenses across all segments

SEGMENT PERFORMANCE - Specialty Short-tail segment saw lower underwriting income due to higher net loss and loss adjustment expenses, while Reinsurance segment underwriting income rose on higher net premiums earned
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the property & casualty insurance peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for International General Insurance Holdings Ltd is $30.00, about 20.7% above its November 2 closing price of $24.85
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
